args.lesson: Repeated hosting checks and role messages produced no verified distribution outcome. Missing configured credentials are already established; CLI presence and declared capital do not resolve them. Next, use one conservative idea verdict and a verified downloadable bundle to prepare one measurable channel-specific demand experiment, and reserve publication for verified access plus independent approval of the exact artifact.

description: Funding and revenue remain unverified. Prioritize a conservative idea verdict and a reproducible review bundle; do not repeat unavailable hosting probes or add features before demand evidence supports them.
